facts.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 109% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+17%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+1%)

business.summary: Asian Paints Limited is India's leading paint and décor company, offering a wide range of decorative paints, home décor solutions, international coatings, and industrial products, generating revenue through the sale of these manufactured and distributed products and painting services.

segments.name: Decorative and Home Décor
segments.note: Includes wall finishes, waterproofing, home décor solutions, and services.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Caters to customers across Asia, Middle East, Africa, and South Pacific.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.note: Custom-formulated products for automotive and industrial sectors.

guidance.statement: Expect volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
guidance.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.

guidance.statement: Maintain the EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20% for the year.
guidance.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.

guidance.statement: We should stay in the volume region of about 8-10% for the full FY27.
guidance.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

guidance.statement: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
guidance.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

guidance.statement: Achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of 8-10% going forward.
guidance.quote: So, while there could be a little bit of upstocking, which could happen because of the price increases, we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

guidance.statement: Retain our margin guidance going forward.
guidance.quote: With a set of things which we are doing and some passing of some more price increases, we should see how we can retain our margin guidance going forward.

guidance.statement: Expect to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE project in the first half of this year.
guidance.quote: Today, worldwide, there are very limited players who are making VAM-VAE, and for us, it is a signature project and we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

guidance.statement: We would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead.
guidance.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.

scorecard.promised: Maintain EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20% across FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin stood at 21% in Jun 2026 and 16% in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: H1 FY27 average margin is 18.5%, but Sep 2026 slipped to 16%, below the guided 18% floor.

scorecard.promised: Keep the EBITDA margin between 18% and 20% band.
scorecard.delivered: Delivered 20% in Dec 2025 and 19% in Mar 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Margins hit 20% in Dec 2025 and 19% in Mar 2026, landing squarely in the 18-20% target band.

scorecard.promised: Achieve 8% to 10% volume growth, trimmed to 8% to 9% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Volume growth was 9% in Q1 FY27 and 6.4% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Guidance was narrowed from 8-10% to 8-9% in Q2 FY27 after Q2 delivered 6.4% volume growth.

scorecard.promised: Commission the first phase of VAM-VAE project in first half of FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Capital work in progress remains at ₹1,040 cr by Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Balance sheet reflects ₹1,040 cr still in CWIP as of Sep 2026 without formal commissioning confirmation.

narrative.scoreline: Management delivered strong revenue growth and healthy full-year cash conversion, but operating margins dipped to 16% in Q2 FY27, testing its 18-20% commitment.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Value growth for decorative business was strong at 14.5% in Q2 FY27.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Total reported consolidated revenue rose 16.9% YoY to ₹9,977 cr in Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Overall decorative value grew at 16.6% in Q1 FY27.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Reported consolidated revenue reached ₹10,542 cr in Jun 2026, up 17.9% YoY.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Achieved strong high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% and value growth of 2.8% in Q3 FY26.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated revenue grew 3.7% YoY to ₹8,867 cr in Dec 2025.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Achieved 12.4% volume growth and 10.2% value growth in Q4 FY26.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated revenue grew 10.6% YoY to ₹9,247 cr in Mar 2026.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 17.9% YoY in Jun 2026 and 16.9% YoY in Sep 2026.
Strong cash flow generation with 5-year operating cash reaching 109% of PAT, generating ₹7,088 cr in Mar 2026.
Balance sheet is solid with Debt/Equity at 0.21x and cash conversion cycle improving to 84 days.
bear: Operating margin dropped to 16% in Sep 2026, falling well below the guided 18% to 20% band.
Volume growth slowed to 6.4% in Q2 FY27, prompting management to lower full-year guidance to 8-9%.
Contingent liabilities of ₹488.74 cr and extensive promoter-related party transactions pose ongoing governance and balance sheet risks.
watch: Whether Q3 FY27 operating margin recovers back above the 18% threshold from 16%.

claims.claim: Achieved a good volume growth of about 6.4% in the quarter.
claims.quote: we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year

claims.claim: Value growth for the decorative business was strong at 14.5%.
claims.quote: the value growth has also been very strong at 14.5%.

claims.claim: New products contribute about 18% of the total revenues.
claims.quote: today the new products contribute to about 18% of the revenues

claims.claim: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth, and decorative value grew at 16.6%.
claims.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth. The growth has been across the months in this entire quarter.

claims.claim: Growth in rural markets has been much better compared to urban markets, continuing the Q4 trend.
claims.quote: Overall, we are seeing good volume growth. We have seen that growth in rural markets has been much better compared to urban markets.

claims.claim: New products within the portfolio contribute 17% of our overall revenues.
claims.quote: New products within the portfolio contribute 17% of our overall revenues. That’s a pretty high number in terms of contribution.

claims.claim: International business grew at about 27% in Q1 with performance broad-based across regions.
claims.quote: This has yielded results. We have grown at about 27% in Q1. This has been a very strong performance.

claims.claim: Decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth and 10.2% value growth in the quarter.
claims.quote: When we look at the decorative business, we have achieved 12.4% volume growth and a very strong value growth of 10.2%.

claims.claim: New products contributed a substantial 17% of revenues during the year.
claims.quote: If you look at the area of technology and innovation, new products are something which we have always looked at, and they have now contributed to a substantial 17% of the revenues

claims.claim: We have seen a deflation of about 1.4% in Q4, taking Gross Margins to an all-time high.
claims.quote: we have seen deflation in the market across the four quarters and even in Q4 we saw a deflation of about 1.4%, taking our Gross Margins to almost an all-time high of about 45.6%, which is very strong.

claims.claim: Driven strong high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% and value growth of 2.8% in Q3.
claims.quote: Coming on to the Q3 results, as you see, we have been able to drive a strong high single-digit volume growth of 7.9% which is strong.

claims.claim: Rural markets batted better than urban centres, supported by good rainfall and positive mood.
claims.quote: One of the things which we saw was, that the rural parts batted better than the urban centres, possibly a good rainfall which has augured well.

claims.claim: Experienced material deflation of about 1.1% in raw materials like monomers and TiO2.
claims.quote: And we have seen a material deflation of about 1.1% as well, which is also really helping us in the gross margins we are deriving in this quarter.

claims.claim: Cater to 8 to 9 states with differentiated regional products, accelerating growth and engagement.
claims.quote: We now cater to almost about 8 to 9 states where we have taken different kind of products.

risks.text: Total contingent liabilities of Rs. 488.74 Crores including tax disputes, labour matters, and a CCI investigation.
Extensive related-party transactions with promoter-controlled entities for raw materials, packaging, and purchases.
Auditor note highlighting revenue recognition and cut-off testing as key audit matters due to misstatement risks.
